name: NAO
summary: NAO is a humanoid robot. Its current maker describes it as "a proven humanoid robot designed to interact naturally with people in education, research, healthcare and elderly environments". The catalogue attributes NAO to SoftBank Robotics; the current NAO6 page is published by Maxtronics. Specifications, maturity and availability have not yet been verified.
